{{Top|leg}}
{{Otheruses|Epsilon}}
'''Voice Override: Epsilon Actual''' was a verbal command that immediately superseded a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] primary programing. This override was activated by a verbal code, usually delivered in the form of a word or phrase. This command was programmed on [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jeremoch Colton/Legends|Jeremoch Colton]] aboard the [[Tantive IV/Legends|Tantive IV]] to prevent the droid from speaking of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] presence, after she had recovered the plans for the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] from [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents on [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]].
